title: libcuflynx module config (*_modules_config.json)
description: A list of module config entries: component entries (module_type, module_subtype, component_file, component_type), and supermodule entries (module_format "supermodule" with the submodule versions it is built from; its instances are in its own module array file). See libcuflynx/utilities/config_schemas.py. Any entry may name a default_parameterisation: a directory under parameterisations/ next to the config file holding <name>_parameters.csv.

port_type.description: Required. The kind of port; ports connect to ports of the same port_type (e.g. vessel_port, flow_port, pressure_port, volume_port, or any name of your own).

variables.description: Required. The module variables the port maps, in order, onto the same positions of the connected port. An empty string or null maps nothing in that position.

multi_port.description: Whether the port takes several connections, and how (libcuflynx/generators/multi_port.py). "True" (or true): every connected module's variables are mapped to this module's (one source, many sinks). "Sum" (any case): the port's one variable is the sum over every connected module (on a volume_port, the legacy blood-volume sum). "Multiply" (any case): the port's one variable, times multiply_factor, sets each connected module's variable. A list gives one "sum" or "True" per variable. Default (absent, null or false): one connection.

multiply_factor.description: Multiply ports only: the factor (a number, or a string holding one). Default: 1.

only_one_port.description: On an entrance or general port: when a connection is made through it, no other port pair of the same two modules is connected. Default: false.

port.description: A port: a named group of variables that connect to the matching port of a connected module (by port_type).

phlynxComponent.title: component entry

module_type.description: Required. The module type an instance names.

module_subtype.description: Required. The version of the module type (libcuflynx BC_type, PhLynx module_subtype). (type, version) is unique across the module configs in use.

component_file.description: Required. The CellML (or C++) file holding the component, relative to this config file's directory.

component_type.description: Required. The component's name in that file.

module_format.description: The format of the module's file: "cellml" (written into the generated CellML model) or another value such as "cpp" (a module the CellML model leaves out). Default: none, treated as not "cellml". "supermodule" is a supermodule entry.

entrance_ports.description: The ports a module listed in an instance's inp list connects to. Default: none.

exit_ports.description: The ports a module listed in an instance's out list connects to. Default: none.

general_ports.description: Ports that connect in either direction. Default: none (null is none).

prefixItems.description: the variable name in the CellML component
"access": the variable is exposed (public) to the generated model; "no_access": it is not

"constant" (a parameter written <instance>/<variable> in the parameters file), "global_constant" (a parameter shared by every instance, under "global"), "boundary_condition" (a parameter written <instance>/<variable> that a connection can replace), or "variable" (computed by the model, not a parameter)

variables_and_units.description: The component's variables: [name, units, "access" | "no_access", kind] each. The kind decides which parameters the parameters file must set. Default: none.

default_parameterisation.description: the parameterisation (a directory under parameterisations/, next to this config file) used when a record names none; ignored if its <name>_parameters.json does not exist

variables_to_delay.description: the variables whose delayed value is needed

delayed_variables.description: the variables that receive them, one per variables_to_delay entry

delay_amounts.description: the delay of each, a number or a parameter name

delay_info.description: model_type cpp only: delayed copies of variables (CVSCppGenerator). Default: none.

^phlynx_.description: PhLynx's own metadata (layout, interface labels); read and ignored

phlynxComponent.description: A module that lives in a CellML (or C++) file. Other keys (licence, creator, notes, ...) are allowed and not read.

supermodule.title: supermodule entry

module_type.description: The supermodule's type (PhLynx keys). Required with module_subtype, unless vessel_type/BC_type are given.

module_format.description: Must be "supermodule" when given. Default: "supermodule" (a submodules list makes the entry a supermodule).

submodule_versions.description: Required. The module versions the supermodule is built from. Its instances and their connections are in <module_type>_<module_subtype>_module_array.json beside this config, whose records each use one of these versions.

default_parameterisation.description: the parameterisation (a directory under parameterisations/, next to this config file) used when a record names none; ignored if its <name>_parameters.json does not exist

interface.description: optional, ordered: a host that lists the instance with no per_submodule_* entry for it is linked to the first entry whose port_type is one of its own ports facing the instance (libcuflynx/utilities/supermodules.py)

submodule.description: a submodule, or a path to a nested one (soma/membrane)

label.description: how PhLynx labels the port (shown only)

^phlynx_.description: PhLynx's own metadata (layout, interface labels); read and ignored

supermodule.description: A named group of modules (submodules) that an instance names like any module; it is expanded into its submodules (<instance>__<submodule>) before the model is built (libcuflynx/utilities/supermodules.py). Recognised by module_format "supermodule" or a submodule_versions list. Its instances are in its own module array file. It has no component of its own. Other keys are allowed and not read.

name.description: A name with no whitespace inside it (surrounding whitespace is stripped): names become CellML component and variable names.
